name: Balsamic Arugula Salad with Lentils, Cucumber, Avocado & Almonds
instructions: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place in a large bowl.
Drain and rinse lentils. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Add almonds and vinaigrette to the bowl, then stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide arugula between plates or bowls; top with the lentil salad. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
